meta.name: ml-model-eval-benchmark
meta.description: Compare model candidates using weighted metrics and deterministic ranking outputs. Use for benchmark leaderboards and model promotion decisions.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 对比模型候选并输出加权排名
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在多个模型间做量化对比和排名决策。
copy.tagline_en: Compare model candidates with weighted ranking
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to compare and rank multiple models quantitatively.

howto.what: Claude 会根据你设定的权重和指标范围，对多个模型候选进行打分和排名，并输出排行榜和推荐结果。
howto.when: 当你需要比较不同模型的表现，或为模型上线做决策时，可以要求 Claude 执行评估。

say.text: 帮我比较模型A和模型B，按准确率权重0.6、速度权重0.4排名。
say.note: Claude 会计算加权得分并输出排行榜。

say.text: 对这三个模型做基准测试，输出推荐升级的模型。
say.note: Claude 会运行脚本生成结果。

howto.what_en: Claude scores and ranks model candidates based on user-defined weights and metric ranges, outputting a leaderboard and promotion recommendation.
howto.when_en: When you need to compare model candidates or make model promotion decisions, ask Claude to run the evaluation.

say_en.text: Compare model A and model B, rank by accuracy weight 0.6 and speed weight 0.4.
say_en.note: Claude computes weighted scores and outputs a leaderboard.

say_en.text: Benchmark these three models and recommend which to promote.
say_en.note: Claude runs the script to generate results.
